display.purpose: Page h1; uppercase grotesk, tight tracking. Homepage masthead runs larger: clamp(2.6rem, 8.5vw, 6rem), line-height 0.9.

headline.purpose: Section h2, always closed with a 6px ink rule below.

title.purpose: h3 and work-card titles; bento card titles are the one normal-case title (600 weight).

body.purpose: Young Serif prose, lists, excerpts, table cells; project posts at line-height 1.8.

label.purpose: Mono metadata at the 11px floor; uppercase for short labels only, long meta lines run normal case at 0.04-0.08em tracking.

shadows.name: letterpress-rest
shadows.purpose: Default button state; hairline highlight on the top edge, shadow on the bottom, pressed into the stock.

shadows.name: letterpress-pressed
shadows.purpose: Button hover/focus; the press deepens as the block turns Registration Red.

shadows.name: bento-ambient
shadows.purpose: Bento gallery cards at rest; the only outward shadow at rest in the system.

shadows.name: bento-lift
shadows.purpose: Bento gallery card hover, paired with a 4px translateY rise.

shadows.name: legacy-image
shadows.purpose: The .shadow-sm shim for older post images only; not for new surfaces.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Colour and shadow transitions on buttons, links, nav tags, rows.

motion.name: bento-ease
motion.purpose: Easing for the bento card lift (0.28s) and image drift (0.4s, scale 1.03). Reduced-motion keeps state changes and drops movement.

narrative.overview:
The site is a printed artifact. The page is paper stock with a subtle two-layer radial-gradient dot grain, the text is press ink, hierarchy is drawn with ink rules of three weights, and a single spot colour (Registration Red) carries every interactive accent. Interactive elements are letterpress blocks: solid ink with the label knocked out in paper, pressed into the stock rather than floating above it. The codebase itself named this world print-object; even the cursor is a printer's registration mark, drawn in paper-and-ink at rest and closing up in Registration Red over interactive elements.

Density is editorial: full-width uppercase grotesk mastheads, serif prose at a comfortable measure, and mono metadata in gutters and labels. There is no dark mode; the one dark surface is the near-black (#0b0b0b) background behind canvases and video, kept so media output is not washed out by the paper. The system rejects the site's former vaporwave theme outright: no neon glow, no scanlines, no terminal window chrome, no cyan borders.

Every Jekyll page and standalone subsite loads the single stylesheet assets/css/paper.css; the homepage index.html carries its own inline copy of the token values, and when a token changes it must change in both places.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground (#efe9dc) with dot-grain texture; ink (#14100c) does all structural work.
One spot colour (#c0330f) for links, hovers, focus rings, and accents.
Three-face type system: grotesk display, serif prose, mono chrome.
Flat by default; depth only as letterpress insets and soft bento-card lift.
Hierarchy drawn with rules (6px / 2px / 1px), not boxes or colour fields.

rules.name: The One Spot Colour Rule
rules.body: Registration Red is the only chromatic accent in the system. If a second hue appears anywhere outside photographic content, it is a defect.

rules.name: The Eleven-Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text sits below 11px. The mono metadata voice bottoms out there; it never shrinks further.

rules.name: The Short-Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for display type and short mono labels. Long meta strings (venues, author lists) run normal case; caps at length are unreadable.

rules.name: The Ink Rule Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is drawn with rules and weight, not boxes or colour: 6px rules close section headings, 2px heavy rules bound page headers, shelves, and footers, 1px hairlines separate rows and cells.

rules.name: The Letterpress Rule
rules.body: Interactive ink blocks read as pressed into the stock, never floating above it. Shadows on buttons are always inset; outward shadows belong to bento cards alone.

dos: Do keep Registration Red (#c0330f) as the only chromatic accent; links, hovers, focus rings, markers, and nothing else carries hue (The One Spot Colour Rule).
Do draw hierarchy with ink rules: 6px under section headings, 2px around page headers and footers, 1px between rows (The Ink Rule Rule).
Do keep button depth inset; hover deepens the press and turns the block Registration Red (The Letterpress Rule).
Do keep all transitions at 0.12s ease for colour and shadow, 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) for the bento lift, and honor prefers-reduced-motion by keeping state changes while dropping movement.
Do keep mono metadata at 11px or above, uppercase only when the string is short; long venue and author lines run normal case.
Do change token values in both assets/css/paper.css and the inline <style> in index.html; they are the same system in two files.
donts: Don't put cyan (or any second hue) borders on images, or any border-radius on buttons, inputs, or flat cards; the system is square except bento cards (14px), chips (2px), and the pill badges.
Don't add typing animations, scanlines, glow, text-shadow, or terminal window chrome; the legacy neutralizer exists to kill exactly these.
Don't set functional text below 11px, and never run long meta strings in uppercase.
Don't float elements with outward drop shadows; outward shadow belongs to bento gallery cards alone, and even there it stays ink-tinted and soft.
Don't box content to create hierarchy; use rule weight and type weight instead of panels and background fields.
